name: Space Runtz Liquid Gold Live Resin Disposable | 1g
description: Blast off with Space Runtz, combining the candy-sweet Runtz genetics with cosmic potency and fruity cream flavors. Featuring beta caryophyllene, humulene, and limonene terpenes, this hybrid delivers euphoric head highs and relaxing body effects that transport you to another galaxy of flavor and feeling.
